name: codex-orchestrator
description: Native Codex delegation with optional external model routing.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate work; interpret evidence and own decisions.
interface.longDescription: The selected parent delegates research, execution, verification, and review through native Codex agents, then interprets evidence and owns decisions and acceptance. Optional model routing is provided by the separate codex-subagent-router plugin.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-orchestrator:orchestration to plan, build, verify, and review this work.
Keep decisions and acceptance with the parent; delegate research, execution, verification, and review.
